name: create_comment
description: Add a comment to a task, referenced by its MOM-label or id.

task.description: the task to comment on: its MOM-label or id

name: create_milestone
description: Create a milestone in a project.

project.description: the project to create the milestone in: its PRJ-label, exact name, or id

health_status.description: planned, open, on_track, at_risk, or blocked (default planned)

name: create_task
description: Create a task in a project, optionally assigned to a milestone.

project.description: the project to create the task in: its PRJ-label, exact name, or id

status.description: backlog, todo, in_progress, done, or cancelled (default backlog)

priority.description: low, medium, high, or urgent (default medium)

assignee.description: assignee: me, a member name, or an email

milestone.description: milestone in the project: its exact name or id

name: delete_milestone
description: Remove a milestone by name or id. This soft-deletes the milestone.

version.description: Version returned by the last read. Omit for compatibility; conflicts during the request are still detected.

milestone.description: the milestone to remove: its exact name or id

name: update_milestone
description: Update a milestone's name, status, target date, health, progress, summary, or description.

version.description: Version returned by the last read. Omit for compatibility; conflicts during the request are still detected.

milestone.description: the milestone to update: its exact name or id

description.description: new longer description; omit to keep, null or empty string to clear

target_date.description: new target date, YYYY-MM-DD; omit to keep, null or empty string to clear

health_status.description: planned, open, on_track, at_risk, or blocked

summary.description: new concise progress summary; omit to keep, null or empty string to clear

name: update_task
description: Update a task's fields (status, priority, title, description, assignee, milestone, due date). Reference the task by its MOM-label or id.

version.description: Version returned by the last read. Omit for compatibility; conflicts during the request are still detected.

task.description: the task to update: its MOM-label or id

description.description: new description; empty string clears it, omission leaves it unchanged

status.description: backlog, todo, in_progress, done, or cancelled

assignee.description: assignee: me, a member name, an email, or none to unassign

milestone.description: milestone in the task's project: its exact name or id, or none to remove

due_date.description: due date YYYY-MM-DD; empty string clears it, omission leaves it unchanged
